# Demo video script (under 3 minutes)

`make video` renders [media/demo.mp4](media/demo.mp4) from this storyline (scenes and durations in
`scripts/video/render.sh`; the terminal scene in [demo.tape](demo.tape)). The video is silent: each frame carries its
own heading and the dashboard card's one-sentence caption. The voice-over lines below are for a narrated version; their
numbers are filled in by `make site` from the same tables as the charts. Snapshot as-of 2026-10-29.

| Time | Scene | On screen | Voice-over (optional) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00 | Title | Dashboard headline tiles (`dashboard.html#capture=hero`) | "Is there a data-backed long-term case for NEAR? We rebuilt the numbers from the chain and kept the ones that survived." |
| 0:07 | Reproduce | Terminal, fresh clone, played at 2x: `make reproduce` rebuilds tables, reports, the essay and the site offline, then 10 falsifiers are scored and the tests pass; `git status` shows nothing changed; the predictions hash and tag | "No keys, no accounts. One command rebuilds every number, chart and sentence from committed snapshots, and the tests check it is byte-identical." |
| 0:44 | 1. Organic collapse | Signer classes with 90% intervals | "Signer by signer, organic human-like use is 2.17% of NEAR's transactions in 2026-Q3, between 0.86% to 3.70%. The rest is reward programs, bots and relays." |
| 0:58 | 1. Organic collapse | Daily active signers, log scale | "Organic daily active signers: 6,437, down from 23,402 in 2025-Q1, but the intervals overlap. And NearBlocks' active accounts undercount real signers 5.2x: relayers hide the users." |
| 1:11 | 2. Intents is real but two-sided | On-chain rebuild vs DefiLlama, 6 sampled days | "We rebuilt NEAR Intents swaps from settlement events. Counted once, they are 46% of DefiLlama's volume; counted on both legs, 92%. The swaps are real; the headline volume looks two-sided." |
| 1:26 | 3. Revenue verified | Monthly revenue, DefiLlama vs on-chain | "Captured revenue is different: rebuilt from the revenue wallets it matches DefiLlama at 98.7%. 3.11M NEAR has been bought back and held." |
| 1:38 | 4. Treasury trail | Sankey of `treasury.near` outflows | "30.17M NEAR left the treasury in April and May. 20.95M NEAR reached staking pools within five hops; the rest ends at unlabelled accounts." |
| 1:53 | 5. Dilution | Supply fans, 2.5% vs HSP-029 | "Holders are still diluted: the float grows 2.12% a year. Offsetting it needs 8.1x today's Intents revenue, or 5.1x if HSP-029 passes." |
| 2:05 | 5. Valuation | Multiples vs peers, log scale | "On its own fees NEAR trades at 2,516x; counting Intents fees, 80.0x. The valuation depends on how much of Intents belongs to holders." |
| 2:15 | 6. What would change our mind | Dated predictions table with sha256 and tag | "7 dated predictions, thresholds computed by the pipeline, hashed and tagged today. If organic use and captured revenue both fail by their dates, the case is falsified." |
| 2:30 | Close | NEAR's role, reproduce command, links | "Built at NEAR HACKATHON. Every number comes from NEAR itself: archival RPC, the FastNear indexer and NEAR Intents settlement events." |

Total: about 2 minutes 40 seconds (`ffprobe` prints the exact duration at the end of `make video`).

## How it is made

1. `scripts/video/screenshots.sh` opens `site/dashboard.html#capture=<card>&note=<heading>` in headless Chrome at
   1280x720 and saves one PNG per scene (the same mechanism writes `docs/media/screens/`, without headings).
2. VHS records [demo.tape](demo.tape) in a fresh clone of HEAD (so no local paths show): `make reproduce` filtered to
   its build steps, three headline numbers and the test summary; then `git status`, the predictions hash and the tag.
3. ffmpeg plays the terminal at 2x, holds each PNG for its scene length with a short fade, and joins everything into an
   H.264 MP4 with no audio, under 3 minutes and 25 MB.

Requirements: VHS (with ttyd), ffmpeg, Google Chrome or Chromium, and the network for Plotly.js from cdnjs. None of this
is needed to reproduce the thesis itself.
